items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: But for me, I’ve always thought that Pepper Adams was a more interesting baritone player as such. At least he touched me in a more meaningful way in terms of what I was trying to do on the instrument

ctx.x: And a big part of that was his writing, right?

Yeah. And it was also right place right time. And it was also being a good salesman. That’s not to take away from his genius. He was certainly an incredible musician and I can only aspire to be a tenth of the musician that he was, he was really of course very important. But for me, I’ve always thought that Pepper Adams was a more interesting baritone player as such.
